introduction_text:
This form is divided into 8 sections:

  -  Reason for Applying
  -  Personal/Spiritual Life
  -  Personal info
  -  Contact details
  -  Education/Work experience
  -  Emergency contact info
  -  Social support info
  -  Finances and payment plan

DISCLAIMER
By filling in this form, you are agreeing with FCE's Privacy Policy and you are opting-in to have your information stored in our databases in accordance with the Privacy Policy. Your information includes any information you submit on this form as well as any information you provide in correspondence with FCE.

You can read FCE's Privacy Policy here:
https://fce.org.za/privacy

You can read the Privacy Policy to find out how we use your personal data. In summary, FCE will use this information to process this application as well as future FCE trainings or work that you take part in. We may add your email address to our mailing list. You can opt-out of these marketing communications at any time by following the Unsubscribe instructions included in the email.

web_form_fields.label: Finances and Payment
web_form_fields.description:
PLEASE NOTE:
We do not encourage debt and we do not want you to go into debt to pay for this  training. We also do not want you to pay for this training and then you cannot keep up with liabilities elsewhere.

web_form_fields.label: Sufficient Financial Resources for Training
web_form_fields.description: Do you have sufficient financial resources for your training?

web_form_fields.label: Source of Funds
web_form_fields.description: If you answered yes, list who is responsible for supplying the finances. If no, how do you intend to raise the funds?

web_form_fields.label: Payment Plan
web_form_fields.options:
Pay 100% on day of registration
Pay in monthly installments through training's duration
web_form_fields.description: Indicate one of the following payment plans. NB! No late payments are allowed.

web_form_fields.label: NB! No late payments are allowed
web_form_fields.description: Students will not be allowed to build up any debts or to continue with their studies if they are unable to settle their accounts.

web_form_fields.label: Agreements
web_form_fields.description: Carefully read all of the following agreements and respond accordingly.

web_form_fields.label: Financial Policy
web_form_fields.description: FCE is an international, non-profit, faith ministry. We are not financially supported by any group, organisation, church or denomination. None of the full-time staff receive any salary. Our running costs are largely met by students’ fees and by contributions from individuals who have a calling from God to support us financially and in other ways. It is also the policy of FCE not to make our needs known outside the organisation or to ask for any financial assistance from any persons, group, church or organisation.

web_form_fields.label: Refunds
web_form_fields.description: All DMT students will be responsible for fees up to the end of the month in which they discontinue their studies.

web_form_fields.label: Financial Agreement
web_form_fields.description: I have read and understand the Financial Policy and Payment Plans of FCE. I understand that the payment of the fees must be on time according to the Payment Plan I indicated. I agree to take full responsibility for all costs of my training. Furthermore, I agree to meet all other personal expenses incurred during my time of study and before my departure.

web_form_fields.label: Financial Agreement
web_form_fields.description: Read the financial agreement above. If you understand and agree with it, type Yes in the field below.

web_form_fields.label: Read the Consent for Treatment
web_form_fields.description:
In the case of emergency, I hereby agree to the performance of such treatment, including anaesthesia and surgery, as the attending doctor or physician may deem necessary.

If you are under the age of 21, you must also print out the Medical Indemnity form to be signed by a parent or legal guardian. Bring the signed form when you report for training or email it to admin1@fce.org.za. If you have not already, you can download the indemnity form at this link: https://drive.google.com/uc?export=view&id=0ByrLPiVMgvW5R2NzbmotdFBqRkdpaklLM05TNlNIcm9MVWE4&resourcekey=0-ae-ylCFGdOK-BgvqJF61xw

web_form_fields.label: Consent for Treatment Signature
web_form_fields.description: If you agree with the Consent for Treatment Agreement, type your full name on the line below.

web_form_fields.label: Agreement
web_form_fields.description:
I HEREBY AGREE THAT I HAVE READ AND UNDERSTOOD ALL THE INFORMATION CONTAINED IN THIS APPLICATION FORM, HAVE FILLED IT IN TRUTHFULLY, AND UNDERTAKE TO FULFIL ALL COMMITMENTS MADE.

I HAVE READ FCE'S STATEMENT OF FAITH AND AGREE WITH IT.
You can read FCE's Statement of Faith here: https://fce.org.za/statements

I AGREE TO FCE'S PRIVACY POLICY. I AGREE FOR FCE TO USE MY PERSONAL DATA ACCORDING THE PRIVACY POLICY.
You can read FCE's Privacy Policy here: https://fce.org.za/privacy
